results.question: How should I check a suspected leaked database connection?

results.question: What should I preserve before cancelling a database blocker?

retrieved.quote: Ask the database owner to approve cancellation of the identified blocker only after checking rollback impact. Killing all database sessions can cause a larger outage. Preserve the blocking chain before cancellation so the underlying cause can be reviewed.
